summary: This Is Your Life is a British biographical documentary television series adapted from the 1952 American show of the same name. Eamonn Andrews hosted it from 1955 to 1964 and again from 1969 until his death in 1987, after which Michael Aspel hosted until the show ended in 2003. A one-off special presented by Trevor McDonald in 2007 was its most recent airing according to the note.
one_line: Overview of the British biographical TV series This Is Your Life, its hosts, and its run from 1955 to 2003 plus a 2007 special.
key_facts: This Is Your Life is a British biographical television documentary.
The British series is based on the 1952 American show of the same title.
Eamonn Andrews hosted the British series from 1955 until 1964.
Eamonn Andrews returned as host in 1969 and continued until his death in 1987.
Michael Aspel took up the role of host after Eamonn Andrews and hosted until the show ended in 2003.
The show returned in 2007 as a one-off special presented by Trevor McDonald.
The 2007 one-off special was the most recent airing of the show as of the note.
